title: Construction Gear Stop
hook: A yellow vest is one layer, not permission.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child recognizing construction stop conditions
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Construction Gear Stop a stop-rule song: high visibility, hard hat, measurement, barriers and tool isolation are safety layers; a vest alone never makes a hazardous task safe.
